    Plot the predicted response against each covariate of one group

    plotPredictions.Rd

    Plot the predicted response against each covariate of one group

    plotPredictions(
  df,
  fuelOrClimate,
  labels,
  value,
  jitter,
  colors,
  fuelOrClimateInd,
  igOrEsc
)

    Arguments

    df

    data.table made in setupPlots(), with columns value, predictedProb, varFac.

    fuelOrClimate

    "Fuel" or "Climate": the group of covariates to plot.

    labels

    Named character vector giving the group of each covariate.

    value

    Unused; value in the plot is the column of df.

    jitter

    Jitter width on x; the height is jitter / 7000.

    colors

    Named vector of colours, one per covariate.

    fuelOrClimateInd

    Index into colors and labels of the covariates in this group.

    igOrEsc

    "ignition" or "escape"; used in the y-axis label.

    Value

    A ggplot.
